question.text: $20 \mathrm{mL~} 0 .1$ (N) acetic acid is mixed with $10 \mathrm{mL}$ $0.1(\mathrm{N})$ solution of NaOH. The pH of the resulting solution is $\left(p K_{a}\right.$ of acetic acid is $\left.4.74\right)$

solution.text: From Henderson's equation, $$ \begin{aligned} p H &=p K_{a}+\log \frac{\left.\mid C H_{j} C O O N a\right]}{\left|C H_{3} C O O H\right|} \\ &=4.74+\log \frac{1}{1}=4.74 \end{aligned} $$
